scene.name: Japanese High School Student Otaku Bedroom
scene.prompt: A compact Japanese high school student's bedroom with a clear everyday-study layout and lively otaku personality. Include a single bed, a study desk, a desk lamp, a water cup, a bookshelf and a bedside cabinet. Use light maple wood, white and pale-grey storage furniture, soft blue and mint bedding accents, practical study materials and a comfortable youthful atmosphere. The room owner is an anime fan, so the walls should feature tasteful anime-themed decorations such as posters, framed prints, pinboards, small hanging banners or postcard collages, while remaining cohesive and believable. Every architectural surface and furniture object must show clear material-specific texture, grain, weave, seams, paper, metal, plastic or glass detail. Photorealistic modern bedroom with Japanese student-room character and no luxury-palace styling.
